subject: general
question: Buffer stock, created by the Indian government, is the stock of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Food grains**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The buffer stock created by the Indian government is a stock of food grains, such as wheat and rice: 
 
• The government procures food grains from farmers in states with surplus production through the Food Corporation of India (FCI).
 
• The grains are then stored in granaries. <
